festivals.name: 168 Film Festival

festivals.name: 1904 Deaf Film Festival

festivals.name: 25 FPS Festival

festivals.name: 3rd i San Francisco International South Asian Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Annual festival in San Francisco, California, showing films from South Asia and the South Asian diaspora.
festivals.status_note: 2026 edition (Oct 9-11) has passed and 2027 dates are not posted. The official site lists no submission call or deadlines.

festivals.name: 48 Hour Film Project - Washington DC
festivals.blurb: Washington, DC edition of the 48 Hour Film Project: teams write, shoot and edit a short film in one weekend, with premiere screenings at AFI Silver Theatre; this listing is the DC Holiday 48 Hour Film Project (Nov 6-8, 2026).

festivals.name: 5Point Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Adventure and outdoor storytelling film festival held each spring in Carbondale, Colorado.

festivals.name: 72 Film Fest
festivals.blurb: 72-hour filmmaking challenge in Frederick, Maryland, with films premiering at the Weinberg Center; teams register as student, amateur or pro.

festivals.name: 72 Hour Filmmaker Showdown (World Ski & Snowboard Festival)

festivals.status_note: 2027 not posted; dates shown are the 2026 edition (shoot Mar 27-30, screening Apr 7, 2026). Fee is a CAD 50 application fee.

festivals.name: 99Fire-Films-Award
festivals.blurb: Free 99-hour challenge to make a 99-second film on a set theme, with the award show in Berlin, Germany; open only to adults resident in Germany, Austria or Switzerland.
festivals.status_note: 2027 edition not posted; dates are the 2026 edition (theme released Jan 29, upload by Feb 2, award show Feb 19, 2026). Entry is free.

festivals.name: A Night of Horror International Film Festival Screenplay Competition
festivals.blurb: Horror film festival, now held in Eau Claire, Wisconsin, that accepts feature and short horror screenplays alongside films.

festivals.name: A3F Film Challenge (Almost Famous Film Festival)

festivals.name: Abertoir Horror Festival
festivals.blurb: International horror festival at Aberystwyth Arts Centre in Wales, with a short film competition and feature submissions of horror and fantasy films.

festivals.name: Abycine Albacete International Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Independent film festival in Albacete, Spain; competitive sections are open only to films with a Spanish-national or Spain-resident director or Spanish co-production, and Hecho en CLM is limited to Castilla-La Mancha work.
festivals.status_note: 2026 call (15 June to 26 July 2026) is closed; entries via Festhome or Movibeta.

festivals.name: Academia Film Olomouc
festivals.blurb: International festival of science documentary films in Olomouc, Czechia, with international, Czech and Slovak, short (up to 30 minutes) and immersive competitions; projects must be completed between January 1, 2025 and February 1, 2027, and the Czech and Slovak competition is limited to projects from those two countries.

festivals.name: Academy Nicholl Fellowships in Screenwriting

festivals.name: Acampadoc International Documentary Film Festival

festivals.status_note: 2027 dates not yet posted; showing the 2026 (15th edition) cycle. Homepage banner says Aug 5-16, festival page says Aug 5-15.

festivals.name: Accordi @ Disaccordi

festivals.status_note: Rules list selection notice both 'by Oct 16, 2026' and Nov 3, 2026; Nov 3 used.

festivals.name: ACE Producers
festivals.blurb: Year-long executive training programme for experienced independent producers, run from Amsterdam with workshops across Europe; applicants must own or partner in a production company in an EU or Creative Europe country (three places for non-EU producers), have been lead producer on at least one theatrically released feature, and bring a fiction feature in development.
festivals.status_note: ACE 36 cycle (applications January to April 2026); ACE 37 dates not yet posted. Event dates span the Leiden workshop (11-16 Oct 2026) to the Annual Reunion (16-18 Apr 2027) per the schedule page.

festivals.name: Achtung Berlin Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Berlin festival whose Made in Berlin-Brandenburg competition is open only to films produced or co-produced by a Berlin or Brandenburg company, or directed or produced by someone living or working there.

festivals.name: ACT Human Rights Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Human rights film festival at Colorado State University in Fort Collins, Colorado; mostly curated, but it reviews up to 50 free emailed submissions a year, films must be from the current or previous calendar year and must not have screened publicly in Fort Collins.
festivals.status_note: Festival dates (12th annual, April 1-4, 2027) are on the homepage. The filmmakers page gives the submission window as October 1 - November 30 with no year printed and does not tie it to a named edition, so dates are left blank until the year is confirmed. Submissions by email to info@actfilmfest.org, capped at 50 films; no fee. Rules require a Fort Collins premiere.

festivals.name: Act One Writing Program
festivals.blurb: Ten-week online Hollywood writing program for Christian writers, with a $50 application fee and $1,200 tuition; applicants submit a statement of faith.
festivals.status_note: 2026 program dates; deadlines listed without year on a page for the June 6-August 8, 2026 program. 2027 dates not yet posted.

festivals.name: Adana Golden Boll International Film Festival

festivals.name: Addis International Film Festival

festivals.name: Jersey Shore Film Festival

festivals.status_note: Year not printed: the official 27th-festival call post gives deadlines (March 13, May 8, June 5, June 12) and festival dates (October 14-18) with no year; 2026 appears only in the URL and navigation. 2027 call not posted. Fees on FilmFreeway only.

festivals.name: Worcester Film Festival
festivals.blurb: BIFA-qualifying independent film festival across venues in Worcester, England.
festivals.status_note: 2026 edition shown; deadlines are only on the submission platform.

festivals.name: Workers Unite Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Labor solidarity film festival in New York City, with some films online; films must be in English or subtitled.
festivals.status_note: Season 15 Oct 23 - Nov 5, 2026; submissions closed. Deadlines and fees are only on FilmFreeway.

festivals.name: World Festival of Animated Film Varna
festivals.blurb: Animation festival in Varna, Bulgaria, with short, student and feature competitions.
festivals.status_note: 2026 edition Sept 2-6; 2027 dates not posted. Deadlines appear only on a submission platform.

festivals.name: WorldFest-Houston International Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Houston, Texas international competition (60th edition) for features, shorts, TV, commercials, music videos and screenplays from any country, for works completed after April 1, 2024.
festivals.status_note: Early Bird fee shown is for features (shorts $60, student shorts $45); fees rise at each deadline and later-tier fees are not posted. The screenplay competition is listed separately (sp-4.json).

festivals.name: WorldFest-Houston Screenplay Competition
festivals.blurb: Screenplay awards of the 60th WorldFest-Houston International Film Festival.
festivals.status_note: Deadlines are from the official site; screenplay entries are accepted only through a third-party platform, and screenplay fees are not posted on the official site.

festivals.name: WOW Wales One World Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Touring festival across Wales based in Aberystwyth, focused mainly on films from Africa, Asia and Latin America.
festivals.status_note: Homepage says 2027 submissions are open but deadlines are only on the submission platform; 2027 dates not posted.

festivals.name: WriteMovies Writing Contest
festivals.blurb: Online screenplay contest run by WriteMovies (listed in Los Angeles, California) whose top three scripts receive a year of development, management representation and industry pitching; every entry gets first-ten-pages feedback.
festivals.status_note: Fall 2026 contest; deadlines from the homepage, fees from the contest page. Quarter-finalists 4 Dec, semi-finalists 11 Dec 2026.

festivals.name: WRO Media Art Biennale
festivals.blurb: Media art biennale in Wroclaw, Poland, with exhibitions running through the end of May.
festivals.status_note: 22nd Biennale WRO 2027 'Friction.' opening events 12-16 May 2027; no open call or deadline posted (page describes curatorial research).

festivals.name: WYO Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Independent film festival at the WYO Theater in Sheridan, Wyoming.
festivals.status_note: 9th edition; 2027 call not posted. Official site is wyofilmfest.org (checklist link was a tourism page).

festivals.name: Wyoming International Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Cheyenne, Wyoming festival of features, shorts, documentaries and music videos, with feature and short screenplay awards and a Best Wyoming Documentary category.
festivals.status_note: 2026 dates from the festival schedule (07.08.26-07.12.26); 2027 not posted. Deadlines only on FilmFreeway.

festivals.name: Xibalbá Latin American Horror Film Showcase
festivals.blurb: Horror and fantasy film festival held in cities across Guatemala; open only to Latin American filmmakers (native or naturalized), films finished 2024 to 2026 in Spanish or with Spanish subtitles, not previously posted online.
festivals.status_note: Fee shown is for shorts; features are $10, and student shorts can request a waiver. Official page says the festival runs in late October 2026 without exact dates.

festivals.name: Xociviga Festival Internacional de Curtametraxes
festivals.blurb: International short film festival in O Carballino, Galicia, Spain, with an international section and a prize for Galician shorts.
festivals.status_note: 2026 edition not posted; 2025 dates shown. Entry only via submission platforms; no deadlines on the official site.

festivals.name: XPOSED Queer Film Festival Berlin
festivals.blurb: Queer film festival in Berlin, Germany, with features, short film programs, the Lolly Awards and a Queer Short Film Fund.
festivals.status_note: 2027 dates not posted. Film submissions go to films@xposedfilmfestival.com; no deadline published.

festivals.name: Y-CAM Film Festival
festivals.blurb: High school film festival in Washington, DC, for films made by teenage filmmakers.
festivals.status_note: Deadlines only on a submission platform; 2027 dates not posted, 2026 event dates used.

festivals.name: Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Biennial documentary festival in Yamagata, Japan, held in odd-numbered years.
festivals.status_note: Films must be 40 minutes or longer.

festivals.name: Yecheon International Smartphone Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Smartphone film festival in Yecheon, South Korea, open to anyone in Korea or abroad, with general, student (19 and under), senior (60+) and one-minute vertical short-form sections; films that won other competitions are excluded.
festivals.status_note: 2026 (8th) edition; event date is the awards ceremony. 2027 not posted.

festivals.name: Yellow Springs Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Film, comedy and music festival at the Little Art Theatre and Antioch College venues in Yellow Springs, Ohio.
festivals.status_note: 2026 window and dates; 2027 not posted. Festival badge covers Oct 1-4, with a kickoff event Sept 30. Fees on the submission platform.

festivals.name: Yellowknife International Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Yellowknife, Northwest Territories festival run by Western Arctic Moving Pictures, featuring films from the North and around the world.
festivals.status_note: Event dates confirmed; no submission information on the official site.

festivals.name: Yellowstone Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Three-day festival in Cody, Wyoming; the 2026 edition screened only films by American filmmakers, with free student categories for Wyoming, Montana and Idaho high school and college students (10 minutes max).
festivals.status_note: 2026 edition passed; no submission deadlines on the official site; 2027 not posted.

festivals.name: YES Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Independent film festival at YES Cinema in Columbus, Indiana.
festivals.status_note: 2026 submissions closed; deadlines not shown on the official site.

festivals.name: Yes, And... Laughter Lab
festivals.blurb: Comedy incubator that gives Fellows training, funding and a pitch slot at YALL Comedy Fest for comedy projects addressing social issues.
festivals.status_note: No fellowship applications in 2026; next application period is scheduled for May 2027 (exact dates not posted).

festivals.name: YoFiFest - The Yonkers Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Ten-day independent film festival in Yonkers, New York, on the Hudson next to New York City, with Q&As, workshops and networking events.
festivals.status_note: Submission deadlines and fees are posted only on FilmFreeway; official site gives event dates only.

festivals.name: Yorkton Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Yorkton, Saskatchewan festival and Golden Sheaf Awards open only to Canadian filmmakers, producers and distributors, for work completed Feb 1, 2025 - Jan 31, 2027.
festivals.status_note: Entries via a submission platform; deadlines stated on the official page. Event dates from homepage.

festivals.name: YOUKI International Youth Media Festival
festivals.blurb: International youth media festival in Wels, Austria, for films up to 20 minutes whose director(s) average 27 or younger at completion.
festivals.status_note: Homepage 'Call for Films 2026' says deadline 1st of June 2026; the call blog page still reads '1st of June 2025'. Fees not stated.

festivals.name: Youngstown Film Festival
festivals.blurb: One-day film festival at Penguin City Brewing Company in Youngstown, Ohio; films must be in English or English-subtitled and made in 2022 or later.
festivals.status_note: Deadlines and fees are posted only on the festival's submission platform; official site gives event dates only.

festivals.name: Yubari International Fantastic Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Fantastic and genre film festival in Yubari, Hokkaido, Japan, open to any nationality; works must be completed from Jan 1 2025 and not publicly released in Hokkaido.
festivals.status_note: Fees shown are for films under 30 minutes; longer films cost more, students 25 and under get 20% off. Run by a new organizing body separate from past editions' organizers.

festivals.name: Yucca Valley Film Festival
festivals.blurb: In-person festival at the Community Center of Yucca Valley, California, open to all nationalities, with a script category; local Morongo Basin filmmakers enter free and San Bernardino and Riverside county filmmakers get discounts.
festivals.status_note: Entries closed; only the extended final deadline is stated. Films must be completed after Jan 1, 2022; scripts from 2019 or later.

festivals.name: Zagreb Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Festival in Zagreb, Croatia, focused on debut and early films by emerging international and Croatian filmmakers; the Checkers competition is only for Croatian short films.

festivals.name: ZagrebDox International Documentary Film Festival
festivals.blurb: International documentary festival in Zagreb, Croatia, with an international and a regional (Southeast and Central Europe) competition; competition films need a Croatian premiere and must have been released after January 1 of the previous year.
festivals.status_note: Submissions via FilmFreeway; deadlines stated in the official rules.

festivals.name: Zanzibar International Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Festival of the Dhow Countries in Stone Town, Zanzibar, Tanzania, showing African and Indian Ocean region films.
festivals.status_note: 2026 program dates; 2027 dates and submission call not posted on the official site.

festivals.name: Zaragoza Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Short film festival in Zaragoza, Spain, with international animation, film school, micro-short and Latin American new talent competitions; the national fiction competition is limited to Spanish nationals or residents of Spain.
festivals.status_note: Rules: entries must be received by Aug 9, 2026 (closes 23:59 that day); some competitions charge a small fee via Festhome. 31st edition runs Nov 18-29, 2026 per the official poster announcement; competition screenings Nov 20-28.

festivals.name: Zefestival
festivals.blurb: LGBTQ+ film festival of the Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur region, based in Nice, France, with screenings in Marseille, Toulon and Avignon.
festivals.status_note: Site shows the 2025/26 edition (Nice agenda Nov 12 to Dec 1, 2025). No submission call on the official site.

festivals.name: Zeitgeist Minnesota Film Festival
festivals.blurb: Five-day festival at the Zeitgeist Center in Duluth, Minnesota, highlighting Minnesota, Wisconsin and Midwest stories alongside international work, with a pitch competition.
festivals.status_note: Fees on the submission platform. Pitch competition uses the same deadlines.

festivals.name: ZINEBI International Festival of Documentary and Short Film of Bilbao
festivals.blurb: Bilbao festival of documentary and short film with an international short film competition.
festivals.status_note: 2026 (ZINEBI 68) call ran 6 April to 1 July 2026; fees not listed. Next call not posted.

festivals.name: Zinegoak Bilbao International LGTBIQA+ Film and Performing Arts Festival
festivals.blurb: LGTBIQ+ film and performing arts festival in Bilbao, Spain, for films completed after January 1, 2024 and not commercially released in the Basque Country.
festivals.status_note: 2026 rules: entries due before March 1, 2026 by email or Festhome. 2027 rules not yet posted.

festivals.name: Zlín Film Festival
festivals.blurb: International festival of films for children and young people in Zlín, Czechia; films must be produced after January 1, 2025.

festivals.name: Zurich Film Festival
festivals.blurb: International film festival in Zurich, Switzerland; only films of 60 minutes or longer are accepted.
festivals.status_note: 2027 event dates from zff.com homepage. Submissions reopen spring 2027; the past-season tiers on the submission page (no year stated) were Early 30 Mar (90 CHF), Premiere-restricted 30 Apr (140 CHF), Regular 15 Jun (140 CHF), Late 30 Jun (180 CHF).

festivals.name: Écrans Mixtes
festivals.blurb: Queer and feminist film festival in Lyon, France; the feature competition takes fiction films over 60 minutes completed since January 1, 2026 and not yet distributed in France, with English subtitles.
festivals.status_note: Deadline from the 2027 English regulations PDF. Entries via FilmFreeway; fees not stated on the official site.

festivals.name: États généraux du film documentaire
festivals.blurb: Non-competitive documentary festival in Lussas, Ardèche, France.
festivals.status_note: 2027 dates confirmed on official page. Programs are curated by programmers; no open call or deadline found on site.

festivals.name: Ícaro International Film Festival
festivals.blurb: International film festival based in Guatemala with national Ícaro competitions across Central America (Guatemala, El Salvador, Honduras, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama).
festivals.status_note: 29th edition; entries only via FilmFreeway per the official call page (registration April 12-June 30, 2026). Event dates Nov 6-28 are from the site header for Edition XXIX, which gives no year; 2026 inferred from the 2026 call for the 29th edition.

festivals.name: Òrbita Film Fest
festivals.blurb: Science and society short film festival in Barcelona, Spain; fiction, animation or documentary shorts up to 30 minutes produced after January 1, 2023, entered via Festhome.
festivals.status_note: 2nd edition. Entry fee not stated.

festivals.name: Ökofilmtour Brandenburg
festivals.blurb: Touring environmental and nature film festival across Brandenburg, Germany, based in Potsdam.
festivals.status_note: 22nd edition runs January-April 2027 (no exact days); submission page requires a login, so deadlines could not be read.

festivals.name: ŻubrOFFka International Short Film Festival
festivals.blurb: International short film festival in Białystok, Poland, with Polish and international competitions.
